codeReview.summary: The on_enter sequencing change is directionally correct (greeting is awaited before the email-tool instruction), but the same commit also rewrites the full system prompt and changes conversation flow beyond greeting timing.

issues.description: This feature commit rewrites the entire prompt structure (Personality/Environment/Tone/Goal/Guardrails) instead of only fixing greeting timing. That introduces behavior changes outside this feature’s scope and conflicts with expectedBehavior: 'No change to the rest of the voice agent behavior.'

The updated flow alters downstream behavior (e.g., email handling and subsequent conversational instructions), which is not required for the timing fix and is a functional behavior change beyond the requested scope.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The fullstack-worker skill lacks explicit guidance for isolating feature-specific hunks when starting from a dirty working tree, which can cause unrelated prompt/code changes to be bundled into a focused fix.
